intro: KENT Grand IoT is an advanced RO water purifier featuring a powerful RO + UV + UF + Alkaline + Copper + TDS Control + UV in Tank purification system that delivers 100% pure, safe, and healthy drinking water. It effectively removes bacteria, viruses, chemicals, heavy metals, and dissolved impurities such as arsenic, rust, pesticides, and fluorides while meeting IS:10500 drinking water standards. Equipped with IoT-powered smart monitoring, the purifier provides real-time information on water quality, filter life, and purifier performance. It also supports automatic service call registration, timely filter and membrane replacement notifications, and maintains complete service and parts replacement history for added convenience. Its intelligent TDS Control technology retains essential natural minerals, while Active Copper Technology enriches purified water with the goodness of copper. The integrated Alkaline Technology provides mineral-rich water with a pH level between 8.0 and 9.5, helping regulate the body's pH balance, reduce acidity, support immunity, and promote overall wellness. The built-in Digital Display shows real-time water quality, filter life, and RO flow rate, while the UV LED Light continuously purifies the stored water inside the tank to prevent bacterial growth. With a purification capacity of up to 20 litres per hour and a 9 litre storage tank, it ensures a continuous supply of purified water even during power outages. Backed by a 1 Year Warranty and 3 Years Free Service, KENT Grand IoT is trusted by more than 1 crore satisfied consumers across India. It has received numerous national and international awards and is certified by both BIS and NSF, ensuring world-class quality, safety, and performance.
